#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    vector<int> dp(n, 0);
    int odd = 0, even = 0, l = 0, j = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
            even++;
        else
            odd++;
        if (even == odd) {
            dp[j] = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
            j++;
        }
    }

    std::sort(dp.begin(), dp.begin() + j);
    for (int i = 1; i < j; i++) {
        dp[i] += dp[i - 1];
        if (dp[i] <= b)
            l = i;
    }

    std::cout << l << "\n";

    return 0;
}
